Frame is done! Real woodsman shelter, good enough to live in!

Warmth feels good... Fingers finally unclenching after logging.

Smoke keeps the bugs away, at least we get some sleep.
Peaceful by the embers... Listening to the crackle, feels alive.

Hope the smoke doesn't draw the dead... Gotta stay alert.

Eh chief... before this mess, never went camping. Now a woodsman.

Sitting comfortable. Warm up a bit, then crash in the shelter.

To hell with this! I'm out of here!
To hell with all of this! I'm out of here!

Keep the axe, I'm making a run for it!

Extinguishing the fire to stay safe... Don't need it in daytime.

Phew... Feeling better. Back to work.
Stretched my back, fingers thawed out... Let's continue.
Alright, break's over. Forest won't chop itself.
Strength's back a bit. Where's the next tree?
Enough sitting around. Back to swinging.
Feeling okay now. Let's chop while it's light.

Warmed up. Time to show this forest who's boss.

Out of breath completely... Blisters to the bone, need rest.

My spine is completely locked up... Need a breather.
Phew... Vision's going dark. Gotta sit down.
Don't rush me, chief! Only dead men work without rest.
Food is great. Thanks, boss.
Alright, alright! Chopping, don't shoot!
Take it easy! No sudden moves, I'm working!
Don't point that at me! I told you I'd chop!

Okay, okay! Lower the gun, I'm working!
Don't shoot, bastard! Heading to the tree now!
Keep your finger off the trigger! I'm working!
Easy, easy! Don't shoot, I'm doing it!

Don't twitch with that gun! I'm on it!
Put the weapon down, damn it! I'm doing the work!

Now that's what I'm talking about! Respect, chief!

Real treat! With treatment like this I'll chop all day!
Strong stuff! Fatigue vanished instantly!
A king's gift in these dark times! Truly appreciate it!
Drop of firewater gives triple strength! Thank you!
Throat wetted, warm blood flowing again. Respect, boss!
Awesome! Haven't had sweets in ages! Thanks boss!

Mmm... Sugar rush kicking in, got my energy back!
Sweets always lift the mood damn well! Thanks, chief!
Glucose hitting the brain, head's clear again! Thanks!

Dusk is falling, time to light fire. Crackling nicely!

Listen man... You treat people right. I'm with you.
Good morning... Sun's coming up, time to grab axes.

Rise and shine, boys! Timber won't haul itself.
Morning chill wakes you up faster than coffee. Heading out.
Morning's here, time to put out the fire and get chopping.
Sun shining through trees... Alive another day. Let's chop.

Not a crumb or a drop since yesterday! How am I supposed to chop?!

Collapsing here... Hunger and thirst are killing me. Share supplies!
Zero energy. Can't take another step without food and water.
I need food, can't work on an empty stomach!
Boss, stomach's roaring loud enough to wake the dead! Need food!
Empty belly stuck to my spine... Toss me some rations!
Can't lift this axe on an empty stomach! Feed me!
Starving to death here! About to eat bark from the trees!
Can't chop with zero food. Give me some canned grub!
Hey chief, food rations! Nobody chops on an empty stomach.
Hunger's kicking in... Hands shaking, eyes blurry. Need food!
Feed me something, will you? Canned beef, stale bread, anything!
Give me water! My throat is parched!
Throat is like a dry desert! Give me water, damn it!
Water... Tongue's glued to the roof of my mouth, dying of thirst!
Chief, got a drop of water? Throat burns so bad I can't speak!

Give me water, don't be stingy! Logging drained all my fluid!
Just three sips of water... Throat's burning up!

Alright, damn... I will chop. Just don't shoot.

Screw you, chief! Not breaking my back for you!
Shoot if you dare! Won't swing an axe under your gun!
I was a free man and I'll die a free man!
No timber for you! Shoot me if you want, not working!
Put a bullet in my head, better than being your thrall!
Got it, back to chopping.
Alright, enough slacking, back to chopping.
Standing up, axe in hand. Heading for timber.
Heard you, chief. Back to work.
Rest is over, let's fell some trees.
I'm ready. Forest is waiting.
Axe sharpened, strength restored. Heading out.
Alright then. I'll sit down and have a smoke.
Got it, chief. Heading to camp, sit by the fire.
Understood. Axe down, going to rest.
Finally some rest... Gonna crash under the lean-to.
Okay boss. I'll be at the camp if you need me.
Thanks for the break. Hanging out by the campfire.
Dead tired... Going to rest by the shelter.
*Takes a deep drag of a cigarette*
*examines calluses on hands*
*sighs deeply and closes eyes*
*stretches stiff joints*
*Exhales a thick cloud of smoke*

*Stretches stiff shoulders*
Good to sit down... At least nothing is eating us yet.
Blowing smoke rings... A cold beer would hit the spot right now.
Back is sore, but tobacco takes the edge off.
Could use a hot meal and some hot tea...
*watches dancing flames*
Phew, my back is killing me... Time for a rest.
Freeze, asshole! Hands behind your head!
I'll mince you into woodchips, beast!
Eat that, scum! Want some more?!
I'll impale you, walking corpse!
Make a move and I'll blow your head off!
Drop your weapon right now, do it!
Stay still and don't twitch!
Wanna live? Hands up!
Face down, dirtbag!
Don't twitch or I'll splatter your brains!
Drop your gun! Fast, while you still breathe!
Take that to the skull, rotting freak!
Water is a lifesaver, throat was bone dry.

Take it easy! I'm heading to the tree now!
Screw you! Do whatever you want, I ain't your slave!

Dog-tired... Need to sit by the fire for a bit.
Damn, my back is killing me... Gotta rest near the flames.

Back off, you freak! Or I'll blow your damn head off!
Get the hell away from me!

Addon: Night/Weather Delay Max (Sec)
Increased maximum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Addon: Night/Weather Delay Min (Sec)
Increased minimum delay during poor visibility (Night/Rain/Fog).
Addon: Backup Spawn Delay Max (Sec)
Maximum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Addon: Backup Spawn Delay Min (Sec)
Minimum seconds until backup arrives under normal conditions.
Addon: Backup Squad Size
Determines the number of bandits (1 to 10) that will arrive as reinforcements after a radio call.
Addon: Enable Debug Logs
If enabled, the addon will print detailed debug information (surrender rolls, AI decisions) to the server/client console. Keep disabled for normal gameplay to avoid console spam.
Addon: Cinematic Execution
If disabled, executioners won't approach and say lines; they will just shoot the surrendered bandit from a distance.
Addon: Enable OmniGore System
Master switch for the OmniGore system. If disabled, amputations and blood pools will not occur.
Addon: Performance & Freeze Profiler
Logs Lua spikes (>= 10 ms), frame freezes (>= 45 ms), and heavy engine call counts to the server/client console.
Addon: Enable Radio & Backup System
Master switch. If disabled, bandits will not drop radios or call for backup.
Addon: Cinematic Radio Subtitles
Enables floating 3D text above dropped radios.
Addon: Enable Surrender System
Master switch. If disabled, bandits will fight to the death and never surrender.
Addon: Drop Weapons on Death
Bandits will drop their equipped weapons on the ground when killed.
Addon: Regular Zombie Gore
Allows shotgun and high-caliber weapon hits to detach arms from regular zombies as well. Disabled by default.
Addon: Gunpoint Surrender Chance [%%]
Base chance (0-100%%) for an isolated bandit to surrender when aimed at by the player.
Addon: Motorized Backup Chance (BanditsVehicles) [%%]

Chance (0-100%%) for radio-called reinforcements to arrive in an armed bandit vehicle when BanditsVehicles / BanditsVehiclesExp is installed. Falls back to on-foot backup if no road is nearby or the vehicle cap is reached.
Addon: Deep External Mod Profiler
Extends the profiler to attribute RealLimbs, Bandits, Viewpoint, and other mods' Events/functions and Render vs Simulation frame phases.
Addon: Radio Broadcast Mode
Multi-Voice Combat (All Radios / Overlapping)
Squad Sector Cooldown (1 Call per Squad / Realistic)
Sequential Queue (One After Another)

Controls how multiple dropped bandit radios behave when several fall together. Multi-Voice Combat lets every dropped radio broadcast concurrently with short jitter; Squad Sector Cooldown limits each clan/sector to 1 broadcast per 14 sec (extra radios drop silently); Sequential Queue plays radios strictly one after another.
Addon: Radio Drop Chance [%%]
Chance (0-100%%) for a killed bandit to drop an active radio.
Addon: Radio Voice & Callsigns Volume
Controls the speech volume for military radio voice lines, callsigns and HQ dispatchers (0 to 300). Set higher to make voice loud and crystal clear over gunfire and static. Default: 120.
Addon: Walkie-Talkie SFX Volume
Controls the volume level of active walkie-talkie audio effects (clicks and static) (0 to 200). Default: 60.
Addon: Prisoner Recruit Chance [%%]
Base chance (0-100%%) that a tied up bandit agrees to work as a lumberjack. Every failed attempt adds 10%%.
Addon: Worker Escape Chance [%% per hour]
Chance per in-game hour that a recruited bandit escapes. x2-x4 when the master is away, x0.5 when he is close; lowered by every delivered log. 0 = never escapes.
Addon: Logs Until Loyal
Number of logs a worker must deliver to become loyal and never try to escape. 0 = never becomes loyal.
Addon: Last Survivor Surrender Chance [%%]
Chance (0-100%%) for the last survivor of a bandit group to surrender.
Addon: Surrender Loot Amount
Determines how much loot (food, meds, ammo) is generated in the bags dropped by surrendered bandits.
Addon: Use Custom AI for Backup

If enabled, reinforcements use the addon's custom search/CQB programs. If disabled, they use the standard bandit AI programs from the base mod (they still move to the radio coordinates initially). Disable this if backup bandits behave buggy.
Addon: Viewpoint Radio Display Mode
Cinematic HUD Subtitles (Top-Down Style)
3D World-Anchored Over Corpses (IsoRadio)

Controls how radio subtitles render when Viewpoint 3D camera is active. Cinematic HUD Subtitles match the top-down look at bottom-center (Small font, 2px outline, red/cyan chromatic aberration glitch, smooth fades, non-overlapping stack); 3D World-Anchored floats cleaned labels over corpses.
